name: white-herb
effect: Held in battle : At the end of each turn, if any of the holder’s stats have a negative stat modifier, the holder consumes this item to remove the modifiers from those stats.
shortEffect: Held: Resets all lowered stats to normal at end of turn. Consumed after use.

flavorTextEntries.text: A hold item that restores any lowered stat.
An item to be held by a POKéMON. It restores any lowered stat in battle. It can be used only once.
